fixed.explanation: _resolve always evaluates highlights in the frame's utility world. Selectors using custom engines not registered as content scripts have info.world === 'main', so they must be queried in the main world. The fix groups highlights per frame and per world, and calls setHighlights in each world's injected script. It sends an empty list to the other world so stale highlights are cleared.
